name: Invigorated Flesh gives the raid 1% hit with all spells and attacks (#3699)
contract: Invigorated Flesh 704632 has a single effect in Spell.dbc: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 333 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, BasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1, radius index 12 (100 yards) and TargetA 1. Its native handler AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll calls both HandleModHitChance (m_modMeleeHitChance) and HandleModSpellHitChance (m_modSpellHitChance), which is exactly the tooltip's "all spells and attacks". relative_to is used rather than an absolute value because base hit chance depends on level and gear.

steps.label: The grouped ally gains 1% melee hit
The grouped ally gains 1% spell hit
